cases.prompt:
subject_definitions:
<Video 1> is the source video for this local video edit, providing the original camera framing, shot structure, visible action sequence, pacing and duration.
<Subject 1> is the pregnant woman’s visible torso, open white shirt and hands in the close-up <Video 1>. Her source body shape and hand paths are retained while the shirt fabric becomes blue.
<Subject 2> is the original window background, visible lower garment and all content outside the shirt fabric in <Video 1>.
Source context: The video shows a close-up of a pregnant woman's belly in a white shirt as she gently cradles it with her hands.

summary:
[video editing] The target video is an edited version of <Video 1>. Change the white shirt to blue, preserving its open shape, the original abdomen and the complete hand movements.
Requested edit: Change the white shirt to blue

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): partially_preserved - apply the requested edit. Change only the white shirt fabric to blue, preserving its opening and folds, the same torso, visible skin and both hands. Preserve the complete sliding and cradling motion and finger contacts in their source order and timing.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - preserve the window background, lower garment, lighting, framing and all unedited colors and visible content.
<Video 1> (cut and pacing structure): fully_preserved - preserve the original camera framing and movement, shot continuity, visible action order, timing and duration.
The requested edit defines the appearance change. The visible subject definitions and unchanged source content govern scene details.

detailed_description:
The target video retains the photographic appearance, lighting and camera composition of <Video 1>.
[Shot 1] The original close-up shows the same woman’s abdomen and hands, now with the open shirt fabric colored blue. Both hands move over and around the abdomen following <Video 1>, preserving the original contact positions and timing. The source window and lower garment remain in place.
The complete visible action sequence and all its phases follow <Video 1> in their original order and timing.

No specific soundscape is requested.

non_diegetic_music:
No specific music is requested.
